title: Implement auto loudness matched bypass RMS tracking and dry compensation
description:
Create Source/DSP/AutoGainBypass.h and Source/DSP/AutoGainBypass.cpp implementing an RMS tracking circuit that compares dry input against wet output to compute a dynamic level difference, then applies a compensating dry gain during bypass preview so bypassed audio is loudness-matched to the processed signal. Use time-smoothed RMS estimators (allocated during prepare) and follow binding rule (1): no allocation, locking, or buffer resizing on the audio path. STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/ for existing DSP module header/cpp conventions and namespace usage
- JUCE/modules/juce_dsp for SmoothedValue/ballistics helpers (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt for the juce_dsp linkage already available to the target (do not modify it in this task)
acceptance_criteria: AutoGainBypass tracks dry-input and wet-output RMS and derives a dynamic dry compensation gain applied during bypass preview
All state is allocated in a prepare method; no allocation, locking, or buffer resizing occurs on the audio processing path
cmake --build build --target ShredBoost compiles AutoGainBypass.cpp without errors
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: allocate memory, lock, or resize buffers inside the audio processing path
